reviews.title: Terrible experience with subscription cancellation
reviews.text:
I spent a long time sending emails requesting to cancel my subscription, and I never received a proper solution nor was my request processed. When they finally responded, they sent incorrect instructions that don’t work from the mobile app, which made the whole process even more frustrating.

I had to search online on my own until I finally found, after quite some time, the actual way to cancel, because the option is practically hidden.

On top of that, I was charged for almost a full year without even being able to use the app, since it didn’t work for me from the beginning. So I can’t comment on the service itself, but I can definitely speak about the customer support, which is very poor.

It honestly feels like they intentionally make the cancellation process difficult so users keep getting charged.

I do not recommend it at all.

reviews.title: Scam / Fraudulent App
reviews.text:
This app is COMPLETELY FRAUDULENT. They advertise a free trial, but they charge you weekly anyway, even while you are supposedly still in the trial period. That is misleading, unethical, and unacceptable.

On top of that, there is NO clear way to unsubscribe inside the app. They make it intentionally difficult so they can keep charging you without consent. This feels like a deliberate scam designed to trap users into recurring payments.

It is absolutely not fair to charge people during a free trial. Apple should not allow apps like this on the App Store. I strongly recommend staying away from this app unless you want to be charged without warning.
